Intel: Kotlin package header emitted as Module and class name resolved via type_identifier fallback (#111, #112)

```go title="Go"
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	tspack "github.com/xberg-io/tree-sitter-language-pack/packages/go"
)

func main() {
	config := tspack.ProcessConfig{
		Language: `kotlin`,
	}
	result, err := tspack.Process(`package foo.bar

class Widget {
    fun greet(): String = "hi"
}
`, config)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Language)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Structure)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Structure[0].Kind)
	fmt.Printf("%+v\n", result.Metrics.ErrorCount)
}
```
